name: Daemonette

bonuses.name: Allure of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: Attack Tests made against Daemonettes use Willpower as their Attribute — ranged attacks use Ballistic Skill (Wil), melee attacks use Weapon Skill (Wil).

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Daemonette must pass a DN3 Fear Test. The Daemonette then acts first in the Initiative order as though they had Seized the Initiative.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Alluress
options.text: An Alluress may lead Daemonettes in battle, using the same statistics with the following adjustments: SKILLS: Default 9, Awareness 11 (Passive 6), Weapon Skill 10. BONUS: Alacrity of Speech: An Alluress gains +2 bonus dice to Interaction Attacks.

abilities.name: Wrathful Summoning
abilities.text: Whenever an Alluress rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, a Daemonette is summoned from the Warp.
